title: Cross-border contacts mini-census — temporary routing + incident comms
summary: Quick census of regional owners, escalation lanes, and short-term routing exceptions for the Nov 2029 cross-region failover drill. Use for comms + on-call overflow mapping.
content:
Purpose: collect a minimal set of contact points and temporary routing preferences for the upcoming cross-region drill. This is intentionally skinny — only fields we will paste into routing configs and the incident bridge header.

How to use: updated by owners below; fill the primary/backup emails + mobile; flag any legal/data restrictions (no PII transit). We will snapshot this sheet at T-24h and publish to the bridge.

RAW ROWS (copy/paste into routing tool):
region,primary_name,primary_role,primary_email,primary_mobile,backup_name,backup_email,backup_mobile,preferred_comm_channel,legal_notes,temporary_routing_tag
NA,Aisha Patel,Engineering Manager,aisha.p@redwood.ai,+1-415-555-0132,Ethan Cho,ethan.c@redwood.ai,+1-415-555-0199,slack,none,route-na-default
EU,Maya Singh,Site Reliability,maya.s@redwood.ai,+44-7700-555121,Liam O'Neill,liam.o@redwood.ai,+44-7700-555122,phone,GDPR - no logs to NA,route-eu-fallback
APAC,Kenji Tanaka,Platform Eng,kenji.t@redwood.ai,+81-80-5555-9876,Priya Kapoor,priya.k@redwood.ai,+65-8123-4455,slack,data residency - check KMS,route-apac-local
LATAM,Diego Morales,Customer Success,diego.m@redwood.ai,+52-55-1234-5678,Sofia Ramirez,sofia.r@redwood.ai,+1-415-555-0200,whatsapp,none,route-latam-spare

Quick checks / unresolved items:
- Confirm mobile/2FA accessibility for backups (Ethan, Maya to confirm by 2029-11-06).
- EU legal asked to confirm whether anonymized logs can be forwarded to NA during drill (Maya - follow up with Legal, jira:OPS-7123).
- APAC KMS key rotation window may overlap with drill; Kenji needs confirmation if temporary key-share is permitted.

Temporary routing rules (to be applied only during drill window 2029-11-09 02:00-06:00 UTC):
- route-na-default: standard NA pool, but if average p95 latency > 280ms for 5m, fail to route-eu-fallback (20% traffic) for validation.
- route-eu-fallback: EU-only model variant; route only if legal clearance is positive. If blocked, fallback to route-apac-local for non-PII traffic.
- route-apac-local: local region; prefer for APAC-origin requests; log-level=low during drill.
- route-latam-spare: LATAM small pool, only if NA pool saturated beyond 90% CPU.

Publish plan checklist (small TODOs):
- [ ] Snapshot this doc and push to confluence: INF-incident-playbook-1492 (Sofia)
- [ ] Add final mobile confirmations (Ethan/Maya)
- [ ] Generate one-page bridge header with names + channels (Priya)
- [ ] Run routing dry-run in staging and collect p95 (Kenji)

Notes-to-self: this is intentionally ephemeral. After drill, convert the validated row set into the permanent contacts roster and a short incident recap with any legal exceptions. Keep raw CSV export in the incident artifacts bucket.

History: created 2029-11-03 by Sofia R.; first edit 2029-11-05 added APAC backup; 2029-11-09 final routing tags and checklist updated.
notes: Informal — expect shorthand. If you add a row, mark your initials in a new column (editor_initials). Avoid posting personal mobile numbers publicly; this doc lives in Drive but will be exported to the private incident artifacts bucket when final.
